firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose who takes the first turn.
clarifications: Each player receives a Keeper, an Item and an Action card before the first turn.
This is a cooperative game: players take turns controlling the same Trogdor figure.
The booklet suggests several playful ways to choose a starter, including Keeper order or chance methods.

sources.title: Trogdor!!: The Board Game — English rulebook

internalEvidence: Downloaded and rendered the rulebook from the official Trogdor board-game site. Printed/PDF page 4 assigns Keeper, Item and Action cards; page 5 says to determine the first player randomly and gives example methods. Its shared-figure cooperative turn context is explicit.
